scenes.title:
A smoother
gate workflow.
scenes.narration: Here is the updated Veri Gate walkthrough. We will follow a vehicle through the gate, then look at the inventory and user changes from your latest feedback.

scenes.title: Driver first.
scenes.takeaway: Scan or enter the employee number.
scenes.narration: Start with the driver. Scan the badge or enter the employee number, confirm the record, and continue to the vehicle barcode.

scenes.title:
New barcode?
Keep going.
scenes.takeaway: Inventory is created during the movement.
scenes.narration: This barcode is not in inventory yet. The workflow accepts it and continues. When the movement is processed, the vehicle is added as ordinary inventory.

scenes.title:
Choose the
direction.
scenes.takeaway: IN or OUT, followed by review and submit.
scenes.narration: Choose the direction, review the details, and submit the movement. After recording it, the scanner returns to the start, ready for the next driver.

scenes.title:
The exit
is recorded too.
scenes.takeaway: Normal driver and license checks still apply.
scenes.narration: The same vehicle can leave through the usual driver checks. There is no inventory completion block. A barcode first encountered on exit is also added and logged in this version.

scenes.title: See what arrived.
scenes.takeaway: Vehicles Added By Scan preserves their origin.
scenes.narration: In the console, Vehicles Added By Scan shows which records originated at the gate. Supervisors can fill in missing details later. Those details do not delay the vehicle's next movement.

scenes.title:
Edit existing
users.
scenes.takeaway: Update the existing record, without a duplicate.
scenes.narration: Users now have an Edit action. It opens their existing details, and saving updates that same user. Changes to the user's role are recorded in the audit history.

scenes.title:
One Admin
role.
scenes.narration: The separate Manager role has been removed. The available roles are Scanner, Fleet Lead, Supervisor, and Admin. Existing Manager user records convert to Admin. These are still prototype accounts; secure login is part of the backend work.

scenes.title:
Approval has
a clear threshold.
scenes.takeaway: Fleet Lead or above for temporary authorization.
scenes.narration: For a driver authorization override, the approver must be a Fleet Lead or above. A Scanner role cannot approve it. The driver checks remain in place alongside the new inventory behavior.

scenes.title: Review the history.
scenes.takeaway: The movement remains available to search.
scenes.narration: Finally, the movement stays in the searchable history. The Android package includes these same revisions. This remains a device-local review build, with shared data and synchronization still ahead.
